instruction: Enable Apache WebDAV modules on Debian 12
output: sudo a2enmod dav && sudo a2enmod dav_fs && sudo systemctl restart apache2

instruction: Check which Apache DAV modules are enabled
output: sudo a2query -m dav && sudo a2query -m dav_fs && sudo a2query -m dav_lock

instruction: Create a WebDAV directory and set ownership
output: sudo mkdir -p /var/www/webdav && sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/webdav

instruction: Configure Apache with DAVLockDB and DAV On
output:
echo 'Alias /webdav /var/www/webdav
<Directory /var/www/webdav>
    DAV On
    DAVLockDB /var/www/webdav/DAVLock
    Options Indexes
    AuthType Digest
    AuthName "WebDAV"
    AuthUserFile /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd
    Require valid-user
</Directory>' | sudo tee /etc/apache2/sites-available/webdav.conf

instruction: Enable the WebDAV site and restart Apache
output: sudo a2ensite webdav.conf && sudo systemctl reload apache2

instruction: Create a digest authentication user for WebDAV
output: sudo htdigest -c /etc/apache2/webdav.passwd 'WebDAV' alice

instruction: Install lighttpd WebDAV module on Debian 12
output: sudo apt install lighttpd lighttpd-mod-webdav && sudo lighty-enable-mod webdav

instruction: Configure lighttpd WebDAV with authentication
Restart lighttpd after WebDAV config
output: sudo systemctl restart lighttpd

instruction: Install ownCloud client tools (occ) on Debian 12
output: sudo apt install owncloud-client && sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ status

instruction: Sync system address book with ownCloud occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ dav:sync-system-addressbook

instruction: Create a new ownCloud user with occ
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ user:add bob --password-from-env

instruction: Scan ownCloud files for a user
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ files:scan --all

instruction: Transfer file ownership in ownCloud
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ files:transfer-ownership bob alice

instruction: Create an external storage mount in ownCloud
output: sudo -u www-data php /var/www/owncloud/occ files_external:create --mount-point /shares --storage-type local --backend local::/mnt/shared

instruction: Install and run Nextcloud occ (snap)
output: sudo snap install nextcloud && sudo nextcloud.occ status

instruction: Install cadaver WebDAV client on Debian 12
output: sudo apt install cadaver

instruction: Connect to a WebDAV server with cadaver
output: cadaver http://localhost/webdav

instruction: List files on WebDAV server with cadaver
output:
echo -e 'open http://localhost/webdav
ls
quit' | cadaver

instruction: Upload a file to WebDAV with cadaver
output:
echo -e 'open http://localhost/webdav
put /home/user/document.pdf
quit' | cadaver

instruction: Download a file from WebDAV with cadaver
output:
echo -e 'open http://localhost/webdav
get document.pdf
quit' | cadaver

instruction: Create a directory on WebDAV with cadaver
output:
echo -e 'open http://localhost/webdav
mkdir newfolder
quit' | cadaver

instruction: Delete a file on WebDAV via cadaver
output:
echo -e 'open http://localhost/webdav
rm oldfile.pdf
quit' | cadaver

instruction: Copy a file on WebDAV server with cadaver
output:
echo -e 'open http://localhost/webdav
copy source.pdf dest.pdf
quit' | cadaver
